hero.name: Diego Estela Lopez
hero.subtitle: Specialized in scalable frontend architectures with React, TypeScript and AI integration.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience specializing in frontend development with React and TypeScript. I currently lead the frontend team at Knowmad Mood for the Mapfre Inversiones project.
about.p2: I'm passionate about building high-performance, scalable, and accessible user interfaces. I have solid experience in application architecture, technical leadership, and integrating AI technologies into modern products.
about.p3: Beyond my developer role, I'm an active tutor at CoderHouse where I've trained over 200 students in fullstack technologies.

knowmad.title: Software Engineer
knowmad.bullet1: Lead the frontend team as project owner, managing Jira, Bitbucket repository and coordinating with the CI/CD team on production deployments.
knowmad.bullet2: Developed critical frontend modules (SCR Reports, HierarchiesManager) with ReactJS, TypeScript and TanStack Query, reducing production errors by 35%.
knowmad.bullet3: Designed the investment portfolio hierarchies module: node system with dynamic parent-child relationships, concurrent editing and multi-level validations.
knowmad.bullet4: Implemented Excel download flows with concurrency control and visual feedback.
knowmad.bullet5: Resolved race conditions and cache invalidation with TanStack Query, improving module stability by 40%.

uma.title: SSR Frontend Developer
uma.bullet1: Led backoffice portal development with ReactJS, NestJS, TypeScript and Firebase.
uma.bullet2: Coordinated a team of 4 developers, defining architecture and code standards.
uma.bullet3: Integrated GCP and Firebase for authentication, storage and push notifications, serving +10,000 active users.
uma.bullet4: Implemented Redux and React Query, reducing redundant API calls by 50%.

coderhouse.title: Backend & Frontend Tutor
coderhouse.bullet1: Trained +200 students in Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, React and JavaScript with an average rating of 4.8/5.
coderhouse.bullet2: Designed technical challenges and taught classes on REST APIs, JWT authentication and production deployment.
